title: The $35K Wedding Is Stealing $266K From Your Future
hook: The average American wedding costs $35,000 — invest that instead and it becomes $266,000 by retirement. Nobody tells you that at the cake tasting.
angle: Reframes wedding spending as opportunity cost: the standard American $35K wedding sacrifices $266K in retirement wealth. Contrarian take in a culture that normalizes wedding debt.
audience: Couples ages 22-35 planning weddings, or anyone who spent big on one and wonders if it was worth it
key_numbers: 1 in 5 couples takes on wedding debt averaging $11,700
Americans spend $90 billion per year on weddings
